Product Manager PRINCE2

Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

Junior Software Developer - Python & Web Applications (m/f/d)

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your team
This job is with Statista R, a vertical business unit of Statista.

Statista R is a world leader in the creation of company, brand, and product rankings and top lists, based on comprehensive market research and data analysis: Statista R recognizes the best.

With a team of over 100 expert analysts and in cooperation with more than 40 high profile media brands across all continents like Forbes, TIME Magazine and Newsweek, Statista R creates transparency for consumers and business decision makers and helps companies build trust and recognition across a plethora of industries and product categories. A team of over 50 licensing specialists based in New York, Hamburg, Tokyo, and Singapore offers the awarded companies meaningful and eye-catching opportunities to communicate their success via logos and other award related products. Visit rankings.statista.com for further information about Statista R and our rankings.

Your Role

  • Design, build and maintain web applications for working with data as a core part of your role, mainly using Python frameworks such as Django and Streamlit

  • Work closely with our senior Data Engineer and other experienced data professionals who build our analytics products and pipelines, learn hands-on about our AWS cloud environment and ETL processes, and help build reliable data pipelines and PostgreSQL queries

  • Prepare, transform and validate data so our applications and analyses rest on a solid foundation

  • Create visualizations and insight reports that make findings clear and actionable, both to make our analyst team's processes more efficient and to produce strong client-facing materials

  • Work with teammates to turn analytical questions into usable features and workflows, and develop repeatable ways to build expertise and value for our stakeholders

  • Support projects based on large-scale, survey-based market research data, and help develop methods that complement our existing ranking products

Your Profile

  • Solid hands-on skills in Python, gained through professional work, internships, research, or your own projects. Experience coding in R is advantageous

  • Experience building web applications with Django and/or Streamlit is a strong plus. Knowledge of PostgreSQL or another SQL database, and basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is also a plus

  • A basic understanding of cloud environments such as AWS and of ETL concepts, and the motivation to grow these skills alongside experienced colleagues

  • Hands-on experience working with data, including querying, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and checking data quality

  • Clean coding habits that make teamwork easy, such as readable code and basic Git workflows

  • Enjoyment in building tools other people use, a collaborative way of working, and the curiosity to dig into unfamiliar problems

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Do

Build

  • Design and evolve Pelico's deployment architecture across Azure, GCP, AWS, single VM, air-gapped and private cloud environments, using Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Standardize installation, upgrades and tooling to enable true one-click deployment for enterprise customers.

  • Standardize CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure practices to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability company-wide.

  • Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth, including GovCloud and FedRAMP readiness for regulated aerospace and defense customers.

  • Use agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment and diagnostics.

Run

  • Own production infrastructure (primarily Azure) and internal systems (GCP, OVH — GCP being our main internal tooling environment).

  • Troubleshoot production incidents: load spikes, data-sync issues, network problems, cloud provider outages, security issues and end-of-life components.

  • Build monitoring, diagnostics and runbooks so customer IT teams can operate Pelico independently.

  • Participate in on-call, pushing automation further — target is ~80% automated / 20% manual.

  • Occasional customer-facing support as IT teams deploy and operate Pelico.

 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments.

  • Solid depth in at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP), with the ability to pick up and work across others — our environment spans multiple clouds.

  • Comfortable with containers (Docker) as the core deployment abstraction.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices.

  • Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset.

  • Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • Strong communication skills, able to collaborate across Engineering, Product and customer IT teams.

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work, and adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows for coding, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting or engineering productivity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm specifically.

  • Experience supporting enterprise or industrial environments (manufacturing, aerospace, defense or supply chain).

  • Exposure to security, compliance or regulated infrastructure environments (e.g. GovCloud, FedRAMP or air-gapped deployments).

  • Experience in customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering roles.

 

What we offer

  • Work on a highly impactful product that users love!

  • Office locations: In the heart of Paris (75011) and Miami, USA.

  • Stock Options: Available for every employee.

  • Hybrid flexibility: 3 days a week at the Paris office

  • Premium Health Coverage: Up to 70% covered by Pelico (Alan Healthcare).

  • Meal Allowance: €10/day worked, covered at 50% (via Swile card).

  • Transportation Support: 50% public transportation coverage or an equivalent sustainable mobility package.

  • Wellness Benefit: Access to discounted subscription plans for fitness, wellness, and beauty experiences through our partnership with ClassPass.

  • Collaborative Environment: We foster a vibrant, growth-focused workplace where professional development and team connections thrive.

 

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition call (30 min)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (1h)

  3. Technical Test onsite: 1h30

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
jobs.description:
ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting

About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

Apply with the button on this page. Links to papers or code are welcome.

Senior Product Manager

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.

Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.

You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

  • Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

  • Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

  • Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

  • Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

  • Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

  • Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

  • Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

About You

  • Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

  • Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

  • Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

  • Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

  • Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

  • Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

  • Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

  • Clear writing: specs, decision memos and release notes that engineers, customers and executives understand.

  • Education: a degree in engineering, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLM tool use or human-in-the-loop workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience on a platform whose components other teams combine: low-code or configuration platforms, data platforms, workflow engines, developer tools

  • Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, ERP or planning software

  • Background in data modeling, ontologies or large-scale data processing

  • Experience with on-prem or sovereign deployments at enterprise customers

  • Aerospace, defense or industrial customers

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • Meal allowance: €10/day worked, 50% covered via Swile

  • Transport: 50% public transit coverage or equivalent sustainable mobility package

  • ClassPass partnership — fitness, wellness, and wellbeing at a discount

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

The client is building a socially connected travel platform that enables users to discover, rent, and exchange homes through trusted personal networks.

The product combines elements of home sharing, social networking, payments, trust and safety, and home exchange. An initial mobile product has already been developed, and the company is preparing for a broader public launch, starting with approximately 200 homes in the United States.

The company is now entering its next phase, focused on strengthening the existing product, improving the user experience, expanding the web experience, and building a scalable foundation for future growth.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Designer to help evolve an existing MVP into a polished, intuitive, and launch-ready product.

The designer will work closely with the Founders, technical leadership, and engineering team to review and improve the existing mobile experience, identify usability gaps, refine key user journeys, and translate product requirements into high-quality mobile and web designs.

The mobile product already has an MVP/beta application and existing Figma assets, while the web experience is less mature and will require more new design work.

This role requires strong product thinking and the ability to work with an imperfect existing product, challenge assumptions, and help distinguish launch-critical functionality from future enhancements. Business priorities and technical direction will be provided by the leadership team.

Responsibilities

  • Review and evolve the existing product and its Figma assets.

    • Home listing.

    • Booking and rental flows.

    • Home exchange.

  • Provide product design recommendations, challenge assumptions, and help leadership distinguish launch-critical UX improvements from future enhancements.

  • Help create a consistent experience across mobile and web.

  • Contribute to product documentation so future team members can understand key UX decisions and flows.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Proven experience improving and evolving existing consumer products, ideally taking an MVP or beta product toward production or public launch.

  • Strong experience designing consumer digital products.

  • Excellent product thinking and UX fundamentals.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma.

  • Experience designing both mobile and responsive web applications.

  • Ability to work within an existing product rather than exclusively on greenfield projects.

  • Experience working directly with engineers and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and design systems.

  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage environment where requirements continue to evolve.

  • Ability to balance product quality with the need to ship quickly.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with travel, marketplaces, social platforms, booking products, or consumer marketplaces.

  • Experience designing payment or checkout flows.

  • Experience with social graphs, messaging, or community-driven products.

  • Experience working with React Native products.

  • Front-end development knowledge or the ability to collaborate closely with front-end engineers.

  • Experience with design-to-code or AI-assisted product development workflows.

  • Experience helping companies transition an early MVP into a scalable production product.

What We Offer

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

jobs.title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
jobs.description:
Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)

Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english)

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London)
Level: Programme Manager senior
Team: Client Delivery
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

  • Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

  • Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

  • Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

  • Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

  • Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

  • Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

  • Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

  • Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

  • Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

  • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Compensation: €56 – €75

jobs.title: Programmatic Advertising Specialist - BENELUX
jobs.description:
Programmatic Advertising Specialist - BENELUX Programmatic Advertising Specialist (Dutch Speaking)

Publisher Success | Amsterdam, Netherlands (Onsite) | Full Time | Permanent

About Refinery89



Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role



Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities



Publisher Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for publisher inquiries, performance discussions, and ongoing support.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each publisher's business needs and monetization objectives.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and problem-solving.


Programmatic Performance & Revenue Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze advertising performance, including revenue, eCPM, fill rates, and other relevant programmatic metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve publisher monetization and overall advertising performance.
  • Translate advertising data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to implement and evaluate optimization initiatives.


Technical Coordination & Troubleshooting

  • Help publishers identify and resolve advertising-related issues.
  • Work closely with internal AdTech and Technical Account Management teams to investigate technical challenges.
  • Coordinate solutions and ensure publishers receive timely updates.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Refinery89's advertising technology and monetization solutions.


Strategic Growth & Publisher Success

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing publisher accounts.
  • Support publisher performance reviews and strategic discussions.
  • Share insights about market trends, advertising technologies, and monetization opportunities.
  • Contribute to long-term publisher satisfaction, retention, and growth.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Publisher Sales, Technical Account Managers, AdTech, Product, and Finance teams.
  • Communicate publisher feedback and market insights internally.
  • Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.


What We're Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.
  • Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including technologies such as Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs, or ad exchanges.
  • Comfortable working with advertising performance data, reports, and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.
  • Knowledge of header bidding, Prebid.js, or publisher monetization strategies.
  • Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
  • Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.
  • Previous client-facing or Account Management experience.


Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

Who Should Apply?



We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

  • Programmatic Advertising Specialist
  • Programmatic Trader
  • Ad Operations Specialist
  • Campaign Manager (Programmatic)
  • Publisher Operations Specialist
  • Yield Optimization Specialist
  • Digital Advertising Specialist
  • Technical Account Specialist (AdTech)


If you have a technical understanding of digital advertising and want to develop your career in publisher relationship management, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Refinery89?

  • Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.
  • Develop expertise in publisher monetization and programmatic advertising.
  • Transition into a more strategic, client-facing position while building on your existing technical knowledge.
  • Collaborate with experienced AdTech professionals across multiple departments.
  • Gain exposure to premium publishers and advanced advertising technologies.
  • Build your career in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.


Interview Process



Our recruitment process consists of four stages:

  1. Initial Screening: Introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.
  2. First Interview: Video interview with members of the Publisher Success team.
  3. Second Interview: Interview with the Hiring Manager and/or senior stakeholders.
  4. Final Interview: In-person meeting with the Hiring Manager and key team members (location to be confirmed).


Ready to Take the Next Step?



Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - German Speaking (Europe)
jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative - German Speaking (Europe)

Location: Remote in the Europe

Salary: Competitive base + Commission

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

About the Role 🤔

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.

  • Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.

  • Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.

  • Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.

  • Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.

  • Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.

  • A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.

  • Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.

  • Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.

  • Native or professional proficiency in English and German is required for this role.

  • Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

Not quite the right fit?

If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

Full-Time Europe

jobs.title: Inside Sales Rep
jobs.description:
Inside Sales Rep

Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients.

Position Overview

LevelUp is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented, and highly motivated Inside Sales Representative (ISR) to join our clients' newly established sales functions. In this role, you will act as a key extension of our clients' global commercial teams, responsible for driving revenue growth by engaging directly with existing accounting and audit firms within their installed base.

This is a high-impact position often tied to the launch of new solutions. Initially, you will focus on managing high inbound demand, guiding current clients who have free credits through their conversion journey from free-to-paid accounts. You will help customers understand package tiers, address their questions, handle common objections, and close deals directly using CRM tools.

Responsibilities will expand to managing portal escalations and executing targeted outbound campaigns to an installed base using usage-triggered events. The ideal candidate is comfortable with high-volume chat and email sales, holds a high standard of discipline for CRM logging, and possesses a strong curiosity to understand products beyond the surface level. If you are a resilient, target-driven sales professional looking to build a career in B2B SaaS sales, we want to hear from you.

Role Details

• Work Setup: Fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.

• Schedule: Requires flexibility to cover fixed, rostered night/mid-afternoon shifts across North American and European business hours, including Philippine holidays.

Reference: 2641-141224

Responsibilities

  • Respond to high volumes of inbound chats and emails from existing clients utilizing free credits or trial periods. Take incoming phone calls when customers request direct conversations.
  • Guide customers through package options, pricing tiers, and licensing models. Manage common objections using provided sales playbooks and close transactions using assisted checkout in CRM/sales tools.
  • Identify complex, multi-seat, or enterprise-level opportunities and route them seamlessly to named Account Managers, providing clear and detailed handover notes.
  • Document 100% of customer interactions, purchase intent, objections, and usage trends in CRM daily, maintaining high pipeline accuracy.
  • Handle "talk to someone" escalated requests arising from self-serve portals.
  • Run proactive outbound campaigns targeting an installed base based on usage triggers (averaging 40 to 60 touches per day across chat and email) and support seasonal marketing campaigns.

jobs.title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Model-Based Systems Engineer

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team.   • Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.


Your Role

We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. DACH is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, UK, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In DACH we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor. The person who takes this role has the opportunity to build a book of business from scratch in a category that every large enterprise will need to buy into over the next three years.

If you have spent the last decade building the right relationships in DACH and you are ready to put them to work in a market that is genuinely early, this is your moment. Who You Are

  • Active network of prospects and decision-makers in the DACH enterprise space

  • Comfortable in technical sales conversations (with CTOs, ML teams, data leads)

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)

Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

Role Overview

The Senior Data Business Analyst / Product Owner is a senior, client-facing member of the Data Products function who leads projects or individual domains within Data Transformation engagements, from the earliest Discovery and Scoping conversations through to Agile delivery and sign-off.

Alongside hands-on requirements, backlog and data analysis work, the Senior Consultant owns the Discovery and Design phase on their projects or domains within Data Transformation engagements, producing a clear scope baseline that enables Programme Management to run change control and enables Account Management to identify growth opportunities. The role brings a consulting mindset: structured problem framing, confident facilitation with senior business stakeholders, and a consistent focus on measurable client value.

  • Location: EMEA - UK, Hungary, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Italy, Spain, Portugal

  • Daily rate: up to 420 GBP

  • Contract duration: 6 months

  • Project duration: December 2026 - June 2027

  • Daily Requirement: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Design

  • Lead pre-project Discovery and Scoping for projects or individual domains within client Data Transformation engagements, applying Infinite Lambda's Discovery & Design framework, standards and artefacts

  • Define project objectives, preliminary requirements and scope boundaries with sufficient clarity to significantly de-risk the subsequent programme or project execution

  • Define data products end to end, including consumers, data contracts and ownership

  • Engage client product managers and senior business stakeholders to frame the business problem, explore the problem space and articulate the business value of the proposed solution

  • Frame the value of each data product with client stakeholders and track benefit against the case made

  • Partner with Account Managers on pre-sales activities to define the initial solution scope, articulate a product-based delivery approach and translate high-level client needs into tangible delivery Epics

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support stakeholder alignment and facilitate sign-offs at key delivery stages, from Discovery outputs through to sprint deliverables

  • On Data Transformation engagements without a dedicated Programme Manager, act as the primary governance interface with the Account Manager, covering scope control, change requests and proactive communication on delivery health

  • Negotiate trade-offs on scope, timeline and resourcing with client stakeholders without escalating

Requirements Management

Account Growth Support

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

Sitting at the intersection of customers, Engineering and Product, you’ll help inform the evolution of our integration and API capabilities and lead agreed features from solution design through delivery. You’ll also contribute to the practical application of AI and MCP across our technical products. Building the future of our technical products (~40%)

About Aphex

Major contractors like BAM, Balfour Beatty, SKANSKA, Kier, MACE, and Murphy use Aphex to deliver their projects ranging from £50 million to multi-billion pound mega projects.

Since launching in 2019, we've grown to become the market-leading solution in the UK and Australia, with aspirations to be where every major project in the world is planned and delivered.

We're tackling an industry that drives 10% of global GDP yet has seen productivity decline for 20 years. It's time for change.

 

The Role

As a Customer Success Associate at Aphex, you'll learn our Land & Expand Engine inside one of the highest-paced teams at the company: the UK Customer Success Hub.

Your job is to help major contractors get genuine value out of Aphex on their live projects. You'll be in the room and on site with planners, engineers, construction managers, and project directors, helping them embed weekly planning routines, daily coordination, and the reporting that makes their projects run better.

This is a fast progression role. You'll start in apprentice mode alongside the UK CS team, learning the playbook by doing it. Within 6 to 9 months, most CSAs are running their own portfolio of projects as full Customer Success Managers. We hire people who are hungry for that progression and ready to earn it from day one, not waiting until month nine.

The team you're joining is in the middle of a step change: scaling the UK book and expanding into new geographical markets. The CSAs we hire now are part of how the UK CS function holds together and grows through that period.

AI is part of how the team works at Aphex. We expect everyone to use it to think, write, plan, and analyse better. Genuine curiosity about how AI can multiply your output is part of the job.

At Aphex we challenge the status quo as a default. As you grow in this role, you'll be expected to propose better ways of working and make them real, not wait for someone to ask.

 

What you'll learn and do

  • Run project deployments. Shadow experienced CSMs through kickoffs, setups, and training, then take the lead on your own.

  • Embed planning routines. Help major contractor teams establish the weekly planning cycle that becomes their project's operating rhythm.

  • Drive daily coordination. Move teams from weekly planning into the daily routines that make site coordination genuinely better.

  • Build trusted relationships across the project. Engineers, supervisors, planners, project managers, construction managers. Hold real credibility at every level.

  • Monitor project health and act on it. Track signals, spot risks early, run plays to fix issues before they escalate.

 

The team you'll join

You'll be part of the UK Customer Success Hub, working directly alongside four Customer Success Managers who collectively support projects worth billions in construction value across the UK's largest contractors. You'll learn by working live deployments with them, not from a training course.

You'll also work closely with our UK sales team to understand how project success translates into account growth, and collaborate with our APAC hub on shared accounts, knowledge sharing, and the global playbook we run across regions.

 

Why this matters

Every project you help succeed means a real project gets delivered better. Less waste, less delay, less rework, less pressure on the people doing the work. You're not just supporting software adoption, you're helping the UK's biggest contractors deliver the infrastructure and buildings the country actually needs.

 

About You

At Aphex, we believe our team should reflect the variety of perspectives in the world we build for. We've noticed that qualified candidates from underrepresented groups sometimes hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the listed requirements, while others might apply when meeting just 60%. If you're excited about Aphex and believe you have the core skills to succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box. Your unique perspective might be exactly what we need.

  • You build trust quickly with people across all kinds of roles and seniority. You've held real relationships beyond the transaction. People you've worked with before still take your call.

  • You've been thrown in over your head and figured it out. At least one specific story (probably more) of taking on something you weren't qualified for and getting up to speed fast.

  • You don't wait to be asked. When you spot something that isn't working (a broken process, a missing resource, an awkward workflow), you take it on yourself to fix it.
