Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)

Your mission

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

What you'll do

  • Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality.

  • Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen, ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products.

  • Champion an AI-first approach, exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently.

  • Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices, working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization.

  • Drive technical alignment across engineering teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience

  • Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture.

  • Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams

  • Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers.

  • Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines

  • Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation

  • Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus.

     

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams.

  • Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications.

  • Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance.

  • Have contributed to open source or maintained internal tools/libraries

 

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • EM Case study Interview

  • Reference Check

  • Offer!

Job details

  • Permanent Position 

  • Full time 

  • Location: Levallois or Berlin or Nantes

  • Start Date: As soon as possible

  • Remote Policy: Hybrid

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles! 

At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from, what you look like. This translates into our recruitment process: Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We don't just accept diversity at Doctolib, we respect and celebrate it!

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin. If you have a disability, let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process smoother for you!

If you wish to exercise your rights or if you have any questions about the processing of your data, you can write to us at hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

jobs.title: Residential Architect
jobs.description:
Residential Architect

TLDR; Davis is looking for a residential specialist, excellent in plan and in drawing, who wants to practice the craft differently than in an agency. We expect around three to four years of experience.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The role

This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. It is not a conventional architect role. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the quality and architectural credibility of our deliverables, now generated in hours; co-producing the architectural plans that go with them; and actively contributing to the development of our plan-generation technology. It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond your own output.

You will run a portfolio of residential projects, under the supervision of a lead architect, from feasibility through to schematic design.

The core of the role

  • Read the local planning documents (zoning plans, development-orientation schemes, easements) and derive the project assumptions from them.

  • Develop massing, circulation principles and capacity scenarios consistent with the regulatory framework.

  • Certify the architectural credibility of what the pipeline produces, confirming that each plan is sound and setting out the reasoning behind it.

  • Develop the project phase after phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design.

  • Produce the graphic documents (plans, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling.

  • Arbitrate between scenarios against programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize best practice, translating what a strong residential plan respects into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, defining the standard a strong plan meets and validating each result against it, with the reasoning.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: around 3 to 4 years in an agency, ideally one specialized in residential work. You have a real command of the residential floor plan and can, from a site and a brief, produce credible, well-drawn capacity scenarios.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients are real estate developers, whose demands are first about speed and efficiency. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Command of the residential floor plan, circulation, orientation, building depths, cores, the unit-type mix from studio to four-bedroom, tenure types (market-rate, social, intermediate, and affordable home-ownership).

  • Command of the planning documents and how they apply, massing envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, permeable ground, parking, land-use categories.

  • From rule to impact, linking a rule to its concrete effect on a plan or a buildable capacity.

  • Project phases, a solid grasp of the phases from feasibility to schematic design, and what each one implies in level of detail.

  • Graphic production, images and diagrams that explain the project and make it legible.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

Why Join Davis?

  • Work on a real transformation of the real estate profession and co-build a next-generation feasibility standard with a high-caliber technical team.

  • Have a direct, visible impact on every deliverable and take part in the continuous progress of the technology.

  • Be exposed to a rare volume and diversity of projects.

  • Join a driven, ambitious team, in a young, growing company where the methods and the tools are still being built and where your expertise truly counts. Enough to learn fast and shape the way we work.

Package

  • Full-time fixed-term contract, with the possibility of moving to permanent

  • Competitive compensation based on profile

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Generalist Architect
jobs.description:
Generalist Architect

TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has sized capacity across several programs, from light-industrial and logistics to residential, office and retail, and who wants to practice differently than in a traditional firm. Target experience: around 5 to 6 years.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

Our clients come to us with a site and a capacity question, on a program that changes from one deal to the next. You are the one who answers whatever the program, and who stands behind the number in front of them.

You will run a portfolio of feasibility studies across light-industrial and logistics, residential, office, hospitality, retail and mixed-use operations. You take these projects from feasibility through schematic design.

This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is precisely working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. This is not a conventional architect position. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the architectural quality and credibility of our deliverables, today generated in a matter of hours; co-producing the architectural drawings that accompany them; contributing actively to the development of our plan-generation technology.

It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond its own output.

The core of the role

  • Analyze local planning and zoning documents (land-use plans, development guidelines, easements) and derive project assumptions from them.

  • Set the programmatic assumptions for the program at hand, its ratios, structural grids and keys, and derive a quantified capacity.

  • Check and correct the outputs of our tools: confirm what holds up, fix what does not, and explain why.

  • Develop the project phase by phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design.

  • Produce the graphic documents (drawings, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling.

  • Arbitrate between several scenarios according to programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints.

  • Stand behind your numbers with the client, and defend them under challenge.

Contributing to the technology

  • Formalize best practice, program by program: translate ratios, structural grids and thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Assess the model's outputs: say what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work cross-functionally with the product, tech and real estate teams throughout the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Working as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve methods and the quality of deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: degree in architecture.

  • Experience: around 5 to 6 years. You have sized capacity yourself on at least three different programs (multi-family residential, logistics, light-industrial parks, office, hospitality or retail). Logistics or light-industrial is one of the three, as these are the programs that matter most to us. You know the ratios that govern each: clear height and loading docks in logistics and light-industrial, average area per unit and parking ratio in residential, structural grid and workstation ratio in office, area per key in hospitality.

  • Software: proficiency in Rhino and Revit is essential. AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: the desire to bring them into your practice and to evolve it is essential. AI is one more tool in your hand, and drawing remains what we assess.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, you cut to the essentials on ambiguous cases, and you know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Core skills

  • Buildable capacity: connect a zoning rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to a program.

  • Programmatic versatility: move from residential to office, to logistics warehouse, to light-industrial or hospitality, and grasp the logic of each quickly.

  • Planning documents and how they apply: building envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, planted open ground, parking, permitted uses.

  • Project phases, from feasibility through schematic design, and the level of detail each one requires.

  • Production of graphic documents: plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity rationale legible to an investor.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Information structuring: organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with the product, tech and real estate teams.

Why join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • Go through a volume and a diversity of programs a traditional firm cannot offer.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company where methods and tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Bilingual
jobs.description:
Implementation Manager - Bilingual

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together.

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers

  • Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge.

  • Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments.

  • Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs.

  • Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users.

  • Act as a trusted advisor for customers, guiding them through the implementation ensuring they leverage and apply Benchling Best Practices.

  • Understand and document customer pain points, advocate for them internally to influence product changes.

  • Identify and work with sales on opportunities for account expansion post go-live.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MS or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Biological Engineering or a related field.

  • At least 2 years of experience in a lab or R&D setting, ideally in antibody discovery or strain engineering or process development. You must be able to empathize with scientists and quickly understand complicated scientific concepts.

  • Software Implementation experience, preferably with a SaaS software company.

  • Strong communication skills. You must be able to quickly and effectively connect with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, IT project leads, and executives.

  • Self-starter with the ability to be successful in a startup environment.

  • Curious, creative, and tenacious. You should be excited to collaborate with customers and other Benchling teammates as a thought partner.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% based on customer and project needs.

  • Fluent or native proficiency in French or German

  • Experience using Benchling, especially if you’ve been a Benchling administrator, is preferred but not required.

 

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, NEUR
jobs.description:
Regional Sales Director, NEUR

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What you'll do

You will set clear priorities, help sellers win complex enterprise opportunities, and work across the business to strengthen Horizon3’s presence in the market.

  • Stay close to strategic deals and customers, helping sellers shape account plans, navigate buying groups, and communicate the value of Horizon3’s cybersecurity solutions.

  • Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Partner/Channel teams, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to align plans, campaigns, deal support, and the customer experience.

  • Use market insight, competitive context, and sales performance data to identify opportunities, focus investment, and adapt the regional plan.

  • Share clear forecasts, risks, and recommendations with sales leadership, and bring field feedback into regional and company-level planning.

  • Represent Horizon3 across the NEUR market, building trusted relationships with customers and partners and supporting relevant regional engagements.

 

Required qualifications

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret sales performance data, identify trends, forecast revenue, and turn insights into practical improvements.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with confidence engaging senior customer and partner stakeholders.

  • Comfortable representing the company at industry events, conferences, and customer or partner engagements.

Travel Required

We are looking for someone to be based 3 days a week hybrid in our Amsterdam office with some travel required.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Senior Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integration Software Engineer

We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Security Operations Engineer

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

wie zijn wij?

Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd.

Bekijk hier onze corporate video.

De stage

Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en helpt bij het oplossen van technische problemen, zowel op afstand als op kantoor. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt.

Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het bieden van eerstelijns IT-support en oplossen van hardware-, software- en netwerkproblemen;

  • Het beheren van gebruikersaccounts, wachtwoorden, licenties en apparaten;

  • Het installeren, configureren en uitgeven van laptops en mobiele telefoons;

  • Het registreren en opvolgen van incidenten en aanvragen via het ticketsysteem.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie.

Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand.

Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen met anderen en bent niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je flexibel en betrouwbaar. Idealiter herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt affiniteit met IT-support en systeembeheer;

  • Je bent leergierig en wilt graag praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele IT-omgeving;

  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van Windows, Microsoft 365 en netwerken;

  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken;

  • Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed.

Wat bieden wij?

Een unieke kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een snelgroeiende, internationale organisatie. Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal binnen onze bedrijfscultuur.

Wij bieden:

At Apaleo, you'll find a diverse, international team united by a passion for learning and building - and we move fast.

We're looking for a GTM Engineer, Marketing (f/m/d) to join our team in Munich, Germany.

You won’t just use AI tools. You’ll help build the agentic layer that supports our GTM efforts: workflows and agents that take repeatable work off channel owners’ plates and make marketing measurably better at creating demand and influencing pipeline. You’ll build on what the team has already started, work side by side with channel owners, and measure every decision against one thing: commercial impact.

Your mission

Support channel owners with an agentic layer

Create the campaign intelligence behind it

You'd be a great fit if you

jobs.title: VP, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
VP, Strategic Finance

Team: Finance (G&A)

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.

Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.

We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.

Why this role & why now

You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.

What you will own

Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.

Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.

Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.

Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.

Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.

Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.

What good looks like

First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.

90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.

Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.

The standard

A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.

Three things must not fail in this role.

  • Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.

  • Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.

  • Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.

That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.

What you bring

  • A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.

  • You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.

  • You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.

  • A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.

  • You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.

  • You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.

Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.

What this role is not

It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.

It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.

What we offer

Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it.

Our current benefits include:

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • Participation in our equity programme

  • Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development

  • The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale

Interview Process

  • Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition

  • Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager

  • Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team

  • Final conversation with the C-suite

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool

If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along.
