jobs.title: Senior Blockchain Intelligence Analyst, Ransomware
jobs.description:
Senior Blockchain Intelligence Analyst, Ransomware

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role:

We're looking for a Blockchain Intelligence Analyst to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in ransomware. In this role, you'll leverage blockchain analytics, cyber threat intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace ransomware proceeds, identify threat actor infrastructure, and generate actionable intelligence that supports investigations, disruption efforts, and evidentiary workflows.

This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and elevate the team's tradecraft through technical expertise, mentorship, and example.

You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating technical, financial, and behavioral signals, and synthesizing fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables internal and external partners to make informed operational decisions.

The Impact You Will Have:

  • Produce impactful finished intelligence on ransomware actors, affiliates, facilitators, and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages, attribution assessments, and operational reporting suitable for investigative, executive, and partner audiences.

  • Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators such as victim payment addresses, deposit addresses, transactions, exchange exposure, infrastructure leads, or IP-linked activity through to full attribution and actionable recovery or disruption opportunities.

  • Trace ransomware-related funds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains, and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties, cash-out services, and recovery touchpoints.

  • Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, threat intelligence, attribution partner data, and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of adversary behavior within the broader cybercrime ecosystem.

  • Own investigative workstreams from discovery through validation, escalation, and written production, including drafting intelligence products that are source-cited, auditable, and operationally useful.

  • Support TRM’s ransomware asset recovery mission by surfacing high-quality leads, identifying seizure or freeze opportunities, and helping partners move quickly before funds are off-ramped.

  • Drive analytical leadership across active ransomware investigations by prioritizing work, maintaining rigorous standards, and mentoring other analysts without formal people management responsibilities.

  • Partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, including investigators, threat intelligence teammates, product teams, and public-sector or private-sector partners, to ensure analytical outputs reflect real investigative tradecraft and support cross-functional operations.

  • Help strengthen TRM’s ransomware coverage by contributing new attribution, refining investigative methodologies, and improving repeatable workflows for lead generation and asset recovery support.

  • Support external briefings, customer or partner engagements, and capability-building sessions where ransomware tracing, attribution, and recovery tradecraft must be explained clearly and credibly.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You generate meaningful attribution, investigative leads, and recovery opportunities in ransomware cases where the answers are not obvious, and the financial trail is deliberately obscured.

  • You consistently produce finished intelligence that partners trust and use in operational, investigative, and strategic contexts.

  • Your work helps TRM and its partners move faster on high-priority ransomware activity without sacrificing rigor, auditability, or defensibility.

  • You improve team capability by mentoring peers, refining tradecraft, and strengthening repeatable workflows for ransomware investigations and asset recovery support.

  • You help make blockchain-enabled financial intelligence a differentiator in how TRM understands, attributes, and disrupts ransomware activity across the cybercrime ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5-8+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cybercrime analysis, threat intelligence, financial crime investigations, or a comparable senior analytical role.

  • Blockchain tracing expertise — Deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques such as mixers, chain-hopping, bridges, peel chains, and layered cash-out behavior.

  • Extensive investigative tradecraft — Demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into clear written intelligence products, including investigative assessments, lead packages, fund-flow analysis, and attribution reporting.

  • Ransomware domain expertise — including a deep understanding of the broader cybercrime ecosystem and the relationships among ransomware operators, affiliates, initial access brokers, malware developers, laundering networks, and cash-out services.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — especially the ability to turn technically complex tracing findings into understandable, actionable intelligence for government and private-sector audiences.

  • Judgment and execution — Strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where timing matters and outputs must still stand up to scrutiny.

  • AI fluency — Experience leveraging AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to accelerate research, surface insights, and augment analytical workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in government, national security, law enforcement, incident response, or mature private-sector investigative or threat intelligence programs.

  • Familiarity with OSINT, cybercrime infrastructure research, and cross-domain analytical methods that combine blockchain activity with off-chain signals and adversary behavior.

  • Comfort with modern investigative tooling, including AI and structured data environments such as TRM, Maltego, Palantir, or similar platforms.

  • Experience conducting HUMINT collection and engaging threat actors via dark web forums and encrypted messaging platforms.

  • Experience mentoring peers, shaping analytical standards, or improving investigative workflows without formal people management.

  • Advanced practitioner-level knowledge of crypto forensics concepts such as manual demixing, smart contracts, bridges, Ethereum- and TRON-based investigations, and OSINT-based data extraction.

  • Recognized subject matter depth, broader organizational influence, and a track record of shaping methodology or high-priority investigative strategy beyond individual case execution.

Team Operating Rhythms

  • Weekly team syncs to align targeting priorities and review disruption opportunities

  • Daily async standups via Slack on active work, returns, and target packages in flight

  • Primary time zone overlap: US Eastern / Central

  • All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

  • Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d) Automotive & Industrie

Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d) – Automotive & Industrie | Deutschland & China

QMH Consulting GmbH · Norderstedt / Remote · Vollzeit · ab sofort

Über uns

QMH Consulting unterstützt seit über zehn Jahren OEMs, Tier-1- und Tier-2-Zulieferer sowie technologieorientierte Industrieunternehmen bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Qualitätsorganisationen, Produktionsprozesse und internationalen Lieferketten.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in den Bereichen Qualitätsmanagement, Lieferantenentwicklung, Audits, Operational Excellence, FMEA, Trainings und der operativen Lösung komplexer Qualitätsprobleme.

Mit unseren Teams in Deutschland und China verbinden wir technische Beratungskompetenz mit internationaler Umsetzungserfahrung. Wir begleiten europäische Unternehmen bei ihren Lieferanten und Produktionsstandorten in China und unterstützen chinesische Hersteller dabei, die Anforderungen europäischer OEMs zu erfüllen.

Mit ASRAD, unserer eigenen Methodik für risikobasierte System- und Prozess-Assessments, bieten wir zudem einen eigenständigen Ansatz zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung industrieller Qualitätsprozesse.

Für den gezielten Ausbau unseres Geschäfts suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d), der bestehende Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiterentwickelt, neue Geschäftspotenziale erschließt und anspruchsvolle Beratungs- und Dienstleistungsprojekte erfolgreich gewinnt.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die strategische Geschäftsentwicklung und den Vertrieb unserer technischen Beratungs- und Dienstleistungen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf OEMs, Tier-1-/Tier-2-Zulieferern sowie Industrieunternehmen in Deutschland – insbesondere mit internationalen Lieferketten und Geschäftsbeziehungen nach China.

Dabei kombinierst du die Betreuung strategischer Bestandskunden mit einer aktiven, systematischen Neukundengewinnung.

  • Strategische Neukundenakquise: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Kunden aus Automotive, Maschinenbau, Elektronik, Medizintechnik, weiteren technologieorientierten Industrien und der Verteidigungsindustrie.

  • Key Account Management: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere wesentlichen Bestandskunden, erkennst neue Bedarfe und baust langfristige Kundenpartnerschaften auf.

  • Business Development: Du entwickelst neue Zielbranchen und Kundenpotenziale, insbesondere bei OEMs, Zulieferern und mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen mit 500 bis 5.000 Mitarbeitenden.

  • China-Europe Business: Du identifizierst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten bei Unternehmen mit Produktionsstandorten, Lieferanten oder Geschäftsbeziehungen in China und positionierst QMH als internationalen Beratungspartner.

  • Netzwerkaufbau: Du nutzt dein bestehendes Netzwerk auf Entscheiderebene und baust gezielt Kontakte zu Qualitätsleitung, Werksleitung, Einkauf, Lieferantenentwicklung und Geschäftsführung aus.

  • Vertriebsprozess & Abschluss: Du führst Kundengespräche, qualifizierst Projektbedarfe, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Senior-Beratern passende Lösungen und steuerst Verhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Angebots- und Projektmanagement: Du koordinierst die Entwicklung von Angeboten für Assessments, Beratungsprojekte, Lieferantenentwicklung, Trainings und Rahmenverträge und stellst eine strukturierte Übergabe an unsere Projektteams sicher.

  • CRM & Pipeline Management: Du entwickelst einen systematischen Business-Development-Prozess in HubSpot mit definierten Zielkunden, Ansprechpartnern, Vertriebsaktivitäten, Pipeline und Forecast.

  • Marktbearbeitung: Du verbindest moderne Vertriebsinstrumente wie CRM, Social Selling und datenbasierte Kundenansprache mit persönlichen Kundenbesuchen, Messen und Fachveranstaltungen.

  • Strategische Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Vertriebsinnendienst, Marketing und unseren Consulting-Teams in Deutschland und China zusammen.

Du verantwortest die Entwicklung deiner Kunden und Vertriebschancen eigenständig und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Wachstum von QMH.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre erfolgreiche Erfahrung im B2B-Lösungsvertrieb, idealerweise im Automotive-Umfeld, in der Zulieferindustrie oder im Vertrieb technischer Beratungs-, Engineering- und Qualitätsdienstleistungen

  • Nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge in der eigenständigen Neukundengewinnung, Kundenentwicklung und im Abschluss erklärungsbedürftiger Dienstleistungen

  • Erfahrung mit Projektvolumina zwischen 30.000 und 500.000 € sowie die Fähigkeit, bisherige Vertriebserfolge anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zu erläutern

  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk oder belastbare Zugänge zu Entscheidern bei OEMs, Tier-1-/Tier-2-Zulieferern, Industrieunternehmen oder Unternehmen der Verteidigungsindustrie

  • Fundiertes Verständnis industrieller Qualitätsprozesse und idealerweise Kenntnisse in VDA 6.3, IATF 16949, APQP/PPAP, FMEA oder Lieferantenmanagement

  • Erfahrung mit internationalen Lieferketten oder Geschäftsbeziehungen nach China bzw. Asien sowie interkulturelles Verständnis

  • Ausgeprägte Hunter-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative, Verhandlungsgeschick und Abschlussstärke

  • Erfahrung im strategischen Key Account Management und in der Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit HubSpot oder vergleichbaren CRM-Systemen sowie Erfahrung mit Social Selling und datenbasierter Kundenansprache

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Vertriebsaktivitäten eigenständig zu priorisieren

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands von ca. 40–50 %, gelegentliche Reisen nach China sowie Führerschein Klasse B

Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt? Wir freuen uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du relevante Vertriebserfahrung, ein gutes Industrienetzwerk und die Motivation mitbringst, unser Geschäft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

Was dich bei QMH erwartet

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 55.000 und 75.000 € brutto sowie eine leistungsabhängige Provision ohne Deckelung

  • Firmenwagen: Ein Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und eine vollständige Home-Office-Ausstattung

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel: Firmenlaptop und Firmenhandy

  • Mobilität: Vergünstigungen für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten am Standort

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Individuelle Weiterbildungen, fachliche Qualifizierungen und Mentoring

  • Direkte Verantwortung: Eigenständige Gestaltung deines Vertriebsgebiets mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Starke Unterstützung: Fachliche Rückendeckung durch erfahrene Senior-Berater sowie organisatorische Unterstützung durch unseren Vertriebsinnendienst

  • Internationale Perspektive: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team in China und die Möglichkeit, internationale Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Attraktives Leistungsportfolio: Anspruchsvolle Beratungs- und Ingenieurdienstleistungen, eigene Methoden und Referenzen bei namhaften Industriekunden

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Erholung und Sicherheit: Bezahlte Krankheitstage und zusätzliche Urlaubsleistungen gemäß unseren betrieblichen Regelungen

Deine ersten Monate bei QMH

In deinen ersten Wochen lernst du unser Leistungsportfolio, unsere Kundenstrukturen und unsere internen Vertriebsprozesse kennen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung, dem Vertriebsinnendienst und unseren erfahrenen Senior-Beratern zusammen.

Du analysierst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, übernimmst erste strategische Accounts und identifizierst neue Geschäftspotenziale in deinen Zielbranchen.

Parallel entwickelst du deine Vertriebspipeline in HubSpot, aktivierst dein bestehendes Netzwerk und führst erste Kundengespräche sowie konkrete Projekt- und Angebotsverhandlungen.

Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist, dass du eigenständig Kundenbeziehungen entwickelst, neue Projekte gewinnst und den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts in Deutschland und an der Schnittstelle zu China aktiv vorantreibst.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Vertriebsprozesse verwalten, sondern neue Märkte erschließen, strategische Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und messbare Geschäftserfolge erzielen?

Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in der Industrie, verstehst komplexe technische Dienstleistungen und weißt, wie man aus Kundenbedarfen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen entwickelt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von QMH Consulting – in Deutschland, China und darüber hinaus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)

Die Rolle

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen
  • Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen
  • Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört
  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen
  • Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen
  • Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben
  • Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen
  • Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen
  • Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen
  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen
  • Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung
  • Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen
  • Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

  • einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,
  • einen reinen Projektmanager,
  • einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,
  • einen Presales-Spezialisten,
  • einen reinen Strategen,
  • einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.

Benefits:

  • Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus
  • Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams
  • Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit
  • Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events

Dabei arbeitest du sowohl an der Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP und Joomla als auch an der Umsetzung moderner, responsiver Benutzeroberflächen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Joomla-Webprojekten: Du entwickelst, betreust und optimierst bestehende sowie neue Webseiten auf Basis des Content-Management-Systems Joomla.

  • Frontend-Entwicklung: Du setzt vorgegebene Designs und Layouts mit HTML, CSS und JavaScript technisch präzise um und sorgst für eine responsive, performante und benutzerfreundliche Darstellung.
  • Template-Entwicklung und -Anpassung: Du entwickelst und individualisierst Joomla-Templates und stellst eine konsistente Darstellung auf unterschiedlichen Endgeräten sicher.
  • Anbindung externer Systeme: Du integrierst externe Dienste und Datenquellen über Schnittstellen, insbesondere REST-APIs, und entwickelst bei Bedarf eigene Schnittstellenanbindungen.
  • Wartung und Qualitätssicherung: Du übernimmst die technische Pflege bestehender Webseiten, führst Updates durch, analysierst Fehler und sorgst für einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb.
  • Versionsverwaltung und Dokumentation: Du arbeitest strukturiert mit Git, dokumentierst technische Lösungen nachvollziehbar und achtest auf eine saubere, wartbare Codebasis.
  • Technische Optimierung: Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die Performance, Sicherheit, Barrierefreiheit und technische Qualität unserer Webprojekte.

Das bringst du mit

Deine fachlichen Qualifikationen

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Joomla: Du hast bereits eigenständig Joomla-Projekte entwickelt und betreut und kennst dich mit der Architektur, dem Template-System sowie der Entwicklung und Integration von Erweiterungen aus.
  • Sehr gute PHP-Kenntnisse: Du beherrschst PHP sicher und verfügst über Erfahrung in der objektorientierten Programmierung sowie im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, insbesondere MySQL/MariaDB.
  • Sehr gute Frontend-Kenntnisse: HTML5, CSS3 und JavaScript gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug. Du kannst Designvorgaben eigenständig in hochwertige, responsive Webseiten umsetzen.
  • Erfahrung mit APIs: Du hast bereits REST-Schnittstellen angebunden und bist mit JSON, HTTP und gängigen Authentifizierungsverfahren vertraut.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git: Versionsverwaltung und strukturierte Entwicklungsprozesse sind für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Qualitätsbewusstsein: Du legst Wert auf gut strukturierten, wartbaren und dokumentierten Code.
  • Verständnis für Webstandards: Du kennst die Grundlagen moderner Webentwicklung hinsichtlich Performance, Sicherheit, Responsivität und Browserkompatibilität.

Das wäre zusätzlich von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit aktuellen Joomla-Versionen und der Migration bestehender Installationen.
  • Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung eigener Joomla-Komponenten und komplexerer Erweiterungen.
  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Composer und modernen PHP-Entwicklungswerkzeugen.
  • Erfahrung mit Linux-basierten Webservern und gängigen Hosting-Umgebungen.
  • Grundkenntnisse in technischer Suchmaschinenoptimierung (SEO) und Web-Barrierefreiheit (WCAG).

So arbeitest du

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du …

  • gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitest und technische Aufgaben selbstständig löst.
  • ein gutes Auge für Details hast und Wert auf eine saubere Umsetzung von Designvorgaben legst.
  • sowohl Backend- als auch Frontend-Aufgaben mit Freude übernimmst.
  • bestehende Lösungen nicht nur wartest, sondern auch Verbesserungspotenziale erkennst.
  • strukturiert arbeitest und deine Lösungen für andere Entwickler nachvollziehbar dokumentierst.
  • gerne im Team arbeitest und dich mit Kollegen über technische Lösungen austauschst.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Abwechslungsreiche Webprojekte: Du arbeitest an professionellen Webseiten und digitalen Lösungen für den Automobilhandel.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. Fleet Charger (Night)

About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 
 

Role Overview 📝

The Night Charger is responsible for ensuring all vehicles correctly charged and ready for next-day operations (incl HGV). They must operate fairly independently, and so needs to be self-motivated and to work efficiently to a plan.

The role owns should escalate vehicle or charging issues quickly, and must operate with exceptional care to avoid damage or accidents.

The Night Charger also supports basic depot tasks during downtime.

This is a safety-critical night role with direct impact on fleet readiness and morning dispatch.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Charge all vehicles overnight according to plan.

  • Safely move vehicles between yard, charging points, and parking locations.

  • Ensure all vehicle and charging issues are logged and escalated using standard inspection processes.

  • Drive vehicles carefully and defensively at all times; zero tolerance for accidents.

  • Plan charging sequences to accommodate longer charging times for HGVs

  • Monitor charging sessions to ensure vehicles are charging correctly

  • Use external charging infrastructure when required to maintain fleet
    readiness.

  • Safely move vehicles within the depot yard to and from charging
    points.

  • Assist with organising depot activity during overnight operations.

  • Support team coordination when acting in a supervisory capacity.

  • Support basic depot tasks (e.g. sortation, handling) when charging activity is complete.

    • Assist with moving equipment, organising cages, or general depot tasks.

    • Maintain safe working practices across all activities.

    • Support warehouse or depot teams during quieter periods if operationally required.

  • Maintain a clean, safe charging and yard environment.

  • Carry out minor overnight fixes where appropriate, such as:

    • Jump starting vehicles

    • Replacing or reconnecting 12V batteries

    • Inflating or replacing tyres (if trained)

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 1-3 years’ experience operating in operational roles or vehicle-related roles.

  • Valid van driving licence is required - >21 years’ old, licence held for >1 year, 0 points on licence.

  • Experienced, confident and safe vehicle handling, especially at night.

  • Comfortable working independently and following clear instructions.

  • High attention to detail and safety awareness.

  • Flexible, willing to support general depot tasks when required.

  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work night shifts.

  • Able to communicate effectively & build relationships.

  • Valid HGV licens may be required.

  • Understanding of electric vehicle charging processes.

  • Basic vehicle troubleshooting ability.

We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

Pour un gestionnaire de paie, une question sans réponse un jour de clôture, c'est une paie en retard. La qualité du support est ce qui fait la confiance d'un cabinet dans son logiciel de paie.

Notre support est hybride : Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA, apporte la première réponse, et notre équipe prend le relais dès qu'un gestionnaire de paie a besoin d'un humain. Pour accompagner l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets, nous structurons une équipe Support dédiée, et tu en prends la tête.

Tu construis et pilotes l'équipe Support d'Alassio : tu garantis à nos cabinets des réponses rapides et justes, et tu restes toi-même au contact des cas de paie et de DSN les plus délicats. Tu fais de la qualité du support un standard tenu, quel que soit le volume.

Legal Engineer Manager, Paris

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Paris. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

AI-ready Solutions Architect - Workplace & Security

Alle wollen Copilot und AI-Agents. Aber ist das Fundament überhaupt bereit dafür?

Wer Copilot auf einem chaotischen Tenant ausrollt, liefert seinen Mitarbeitenden einen sehr schnellen Weg zu Daten, die sie nie sehen sollten. Plötzlich findet jemand die Lohnliste der Geschäftsleitung oder den Entwurf zur Reorganisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass das nicht passiert: Du machst Workplace- und Cloud-Umgebungen von Schweizer Unternehmen bereit für AI, sicher und sauber aufgesetzt, hands-on und mit eigener Handschrift.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

  • Fundament legen: Du entwirfst Zielarchitekturen für Modern Workplaces mit Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Windows 365 und Azure Virtual Desktop.

  • AI-ready machen: Du räumst Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Datenklassifizierung auf, damit Copilot und Agents nur sehen, was sie sehen dürfen.

  • Absichern: Du entwickelst Security- und Governance-Konzepte mit Defender, Purview und Agent 365.

  • Automatisieren: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, löst du mit Graph API, PowerShell oder Infrastructure as Code.

  • Richtung geben: Du analysierst Kundenumgebungen, setzt klare Prioritäten und erklärst sie so, dass Technik und Management wissen, was als Nächstes passiert. Neue Microsoft- und AI-Features testest du, bevor sie beim Kunden ankommen.


Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du Intune, Entra ID und M365 konfigurieren kannst und auch erklären kannst, warum etwas so sein muss. Azure und Defender sind dir nicht fremd.

  • du mehrere Jahre im Microsoft-Cloud- oder Security-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie Tenants in der Realität aussehen.

  • du ein Studium an einer FH oder HF abgeschlossen hast oder auf anderem Weg ein Niveau erreicht hast, das sich damit messen kann.

  • du einem CIO in fünf Minuten erklären kannst, warum sein Copilot-Rollout noch warten muss, und er sich danach bei dir bedankt.

  • du Copilot, Agents oder Purview schon ausprobiert hast, weil es dich interessiert hat und nicht weil es jemand verlangt hat.

  • du auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän kommunizierst.

GTM Director
We're looking for a commercially driven Go-To-Market leader to own how Treatwell takes its Financial Services products to market across Europe. Working closely with our sales teams and leaders, and with Product, you'll turn our roadmap into revenue, with a particular focus on growing our financial services product line. 

At Treatwell we don't just sell software: we help Europe's best salons and spas digitalise their business, grow their revenue and improve the experience they offer their clients.

You'll be the strategic owner of go-to-market for Treatwell across Europe. With a strong commercial mindset and a highly collaborative approach, you'll define how we position, price, package and launch our products, and partner with Sales to turn them into real, measurable revenue.

You will be responsible for:

  • Commercial go-to-market strategy: Own and lead Treatwell's European go-to-market strategy for its new suite of Financial Services products, defining target segments, positioning, pricing, packaging and commercial priorities, with a clear focus on revenue growth.
  • Financial services revenue: Own and lead projects that drive revenue for the financial services product line, from payments to new financial solutions, setting clear targets and taking accountability for results.
  • Sales partnership: Work closely with our sales teams and sales leaders across markets to shape commercial plans and targets, and turn go-to-market strategy into pipeline, deals and revenue.
  • Sales enablement & playbooks: Build scalable playbooks, pricing guidance, sales narratives and training that help local market teams sell our products and drive adoption on the ground.
  • Product launches: Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market, from validation and pilots through to full European rollout, bringing the commercial and customer perspective into the roadmap.
  • Product-led growth: Alongside our sales teams, build in-app and self-serve sales motions that help adoption and revenue scale efficiently.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and local market teams to embed payments into acquisition, onboarding, account management and retention.
  • Strategy into execution: Translate strategy into clear execution plans with owners, timelines and KPIs, proactively removing blockers and driving accountability across teams that don't report directly into the role.

Senior Product Designer

At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience across our participant-facing ecosystem: web, native mobile, and our Chrome extension.

You combine sharp interaction and visual craft with systems-level thinking, keeping the experience unified across both platforms. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering in a fast-paced environment powered by AI-augmented workflows.

You default to extreme ownership. You define the product vision, hold the bar for what ships, and identify critical gaps before anyone asks.

This is a wide-scope, fully hands-on IC role focused on driving participant growth. As you get up to speed and evaluate the ecosystem, we expect you to identify where design bottlenecks lie and make the case for how we scale the function over time.

How we work

AI environments like Claude and Cursor are first-class design tools here. We don’t throw static specs over the fence or get bogged down in alignment decks. Instead, we use AI tooling to spin up interactive prototypes and live code early, letting us test real interactions and iterate on actual software.

We operate as curious, low-ego builders who value showing over theorizing. We share unfinished work early, critique often, and solve problems collaboratively across disciplines. You will have a direct hand in shaping both our product ecosystem and the way we build together.

What you'll do

  • Set cross-surface product vision: Define and drive the design direction across mobile, web, and our Chrome extension, ensuring the ecosystem feels intuitive, cohesive, and unified.
  • Act as a core product thought partner: Collaborate across multiple PM work streams to sharpen product strategy, deconstruct complex problems, and find simpler, faster paths to release.
  • Execute hands-on at high velocity: Design core flows, components, and high-fidelity interfaces yourself, leveraging modern AI tooling to maintain quality across a wide footprint.
  • Bridge design and native engineering: Work in lockstep with engineers to navigate platform-specific constraints, inspect implementations, and ensure production releases match the intended design fidelity.
  • Evaluate and evolve design infrastructure: Audit our component libraries and design tokens across all surfaces, establishing a scalable foundation and identifying where future design investments or resources are needed.
  • Drive collaborative product discovery: Partner with Product and Research to uncover participant needs, while independently spotting usability gaps and growth bottlenecks to shape upcoming initiatives.
  • Directly inspect post-launch performance: Pull data, synthesize participant feedback, and query product telemetry directly via AI tools and MCPs to iterate fast on live features without waiting in a reporting queue.

What you bring

  • Senior-level multi-surface craft: Shipped portfolio work showing exceptional visual and interaction design across native mobile, web, and extensions.
  • Design system governance: Proven experience building, maintaining, and governing design systems in direct partnership with engineering, including keeping components, design tokens, and interaction patterns aligned across multiple connected platforms.
  • Strong systems thinking: You naturally look for recurring patterns, reusable frameworks, and structural solutions rather than one-off fixes, without sacrificing visual polish or interaction craft.
  • AI-native daily workflow: Hands-on mastery of modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and production design.
  • High technical fluency: Deep interest in frontend implementation details, component architecture, and the mechanics of how software gets built.
  • Vision plus execution: Comfort operating at 30,000 feet to shape product strategy, then immediately dropping down to design high-fidelity details.
  • Extreme agency & ownership: You identify problems before anyone flags them and own the quality bar from kickoff through release.
  • Comfort with evolving environments: High resilience and autonomy inside a fast-moving team that is actively establishing its operating model.

Nice to have

  • Marketplace experience: Background designing for two-sided marketplaces, dual-sided user journeys, or platform dynamics.
  • Front-end fluency: Practical experience writing code (especially modern React, HTML, and CSS) to build production-grade prototypes or ship interface polish directly.
  • Micro-interaction & motion craft: Hands-on experience with motion design (e.g., Rive, Lottie, or code-based transitions) to bring nuance, feedback, and personality to interface states.
  • Mentorship & leadership instincts: Experience mentoring other designers, leading design crits, or helping scale a small design function.

jobs.title: Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d)

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients.

You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. You will design the processes, integrations and reporting that connect these questions, lead complex customer engagements and help other consultants deliver the service. You will advise on hardening and help clients establish ownership, remediation targets and a process that fits their IT operations.

You will also shape what we build next. Starting from our existing Vulnerability Management capabilities, you will develop the technical roadmap towards Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and assess where Attack Surface analysis, exposure validation and Quantum Readiness belong in the offering. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance;
  • Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work;
  • Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality;
  • Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions;
  • Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management;
  • Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible;
  • Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions;
  • Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping;
  • Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience;
  • Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements;
  • Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls;
  • Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality;
  • Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear;
  • Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. Familiarity with ITSM and remediation platforms is expected; scripting and API skills are an advantage;
  • Ability to design a solution across several tools and processes, explain the technical choices and guide colleagues through implementation. Experience developing a consulting service is an advantage;
  • Interest in developing CTEM and Quantum Readiness services and testing AI applications in security operations. Experience evaluating AI or agentic solutions is an advantage. Experience with Attack Surface analysis, Crypto Agility or Post Quantum Cryptography is welcome; you do not need to be an expert in every area on day one;
  • Fluent business English and professional fluency in the relevant local language(s).

Benefits

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;
  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 70.000 EUR p.a. – 100.000 EUR p.a.;
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;
  • 30 holidays;
  • Company Pension Scheme;
  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

  • Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.
  • The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable.
  • Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted.
  • Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools.

We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input.

The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants.

Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité du secteur de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Vos missions

  • Piloter, en tant que référent(e) opérationnel(le), l’accompagnement du changement et de la transformation pour la préparation au go-live de la migration d’ENGIE France sur Kaluza, de la planification jusqu’à la bascule, l’hypercare et la transition vers le déploiement à plus grande échelle, afin que les équipes d’ENGIE soient prêtes et confiantes pour adopter la plateforme dès le premier jour.

  • Définir l’approche de conduite du changement du programme : analyse des parties prenantes, évaluation des impacts du changement, conception des formations et mobilisation pour la préparation métier, adaptées au contexte opérationnel d’ENGIE France et portées par leurs équipes.

  • Faire vivre la gouvernance de préparation métier de Kaluza : stage gates, preuves de préparation, suivi des risques et des dépendances, et reporting hebdomadaire.

  • Collaborer avec le ou la Learning and Adoption Specialist en France pour coordonner la formation, le Train the Trainer et les contenus de connaissance, afin que l’accompagnement soit en place à chaque incrément du programme, au fil de la construction et de la livraison des fonctionnalités en mode Agile.

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) d’ENGIE France sur la préparation métier, le changement et l’adoption, en apportant des conseils pratiques à leurs responsables de transformation.

  • Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives.

  • Améliorer le playbook de préparation de Kaluza : faire évoluer ce qui a fonctionné sur ENGIE Belgique, tester des correctifs là où cela ne suffit pas en France, et partager vos enseignements avec vos collègues de Client Delivery pour façonner les fondations opérationnelles de la plateforme, ses améliorations et nos standards globaux.

Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes :

  • Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

  • Parties prenantes, sponsors et réseaux du changement : cartographier les parties prenantes et leur influence au niveau de chaque chantier, aider les sponsors à rester visibles et engagés, et structurer les réseaux de champions, de super-utilisateurs et de managers qui porteront le changement au sein du business d’ENGIE.

  • Communication et résistances : soutenir la stratégie de communication et d’engagement d’ENGIE France, afin que leurs équipes et leurs clients entendent un discours cohérent et positif sur le programme. Vous aiderez les dirigeants et les champions à porter le changement, en interne comme auprès des clients, et vous anticiperez les zones où des résistances pourraient apparaître afin d’intervenir avant qu’elles ne s’installent.

  • Migration et préparation au go-live : constituer les preuves de préparation métier et opérationnelle qui permettent un transfert fluide vers l’exploitation, mesurées par rapport aux critères d’acceptation convenus, et soutenir le centre de commandement du go-live.

  • Hypercare et stabilisation : définir les critères d’entrée et de sortie de l’hypercare, suivre les signaux de stabilité et d’adoption, et assurer une passation propre aux équipes d’exploitation d’ENGIE.

  • Premières versions et solutions de contournement : anticiper les limitations connues des premières versions et les refléter dans les formations, les contenus de connaissance et les communications, pour que les utilisateurs ne soient jamais pris au dépourvu. Vous travaillerez avec le Release Management pour que chaque version de la plateforme arrive avec l’accompagnement nécessaire.

Votre profil

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Plusieurs années d’expérience opérationnelle en conduite du changement sur de grandes transformations de plateformes ou de systèmes, avec une discipline de change management reconnue. Vous résolvez avec créativité une grande variété de problèmes et travaillez avec peu de supervision.

  • Une expérience dans des environnements opérationnels régulés et en contact avec les clients, incluant la migration de comptes clients en production, la bascule et le go-live, où vous avez contribué à définir l’approche plutôt que de simplement en suivre une.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive

At Deeploy, we help organisations roll out AI they can trust. Banks, insurers and pharma companies have to show they control their AI use, and most don’t yet have the tooling to do so. Deeploy gives them that control. We work with dozens of enterprise customers in finance, insurance and healthcare.

You’ll own deals from first outreach to signed contract, with a focus on the Netherlands and Northwest Europe. Most of our buyers have never bought AI governance before, so much of the work is helping them define the problem and build the internal case. You report to the COO, and the founders stay involved in deals.

What you’ll do

  • Deals: run enterprise deals from qualification to close. Deals typically take 6 to 12 months and involve risk, compliance, legal, IT and a business sponsor. The GRC (governance, risk and compliance) function is often the way in.

  • Pipeline: build a large part of your own pipeline through outbound, your network, our partners and events. Marketing runs campaigns with you.

  • Visibility: speak at events and roundtables for risk, compliance and AI governance audiences.

  • Feedback: bring back what buyers respond to, how they compare us with alternatives, and what they miss in the product.

  • Process: help set up how we qualify, forecast and run deals, and later how we onboard new sellers. We’re a small team that works with AI daily, so you’ll also build some of your own tools and agents.

After 12 months

  • You’ve closed at least 4 new enterprise accounts and built €1m+ of qualified pipeline.

  • AI Governance officers know Deeploy, and know you.

  • You have proven to yourself as part of our team, culture and processes.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve closed complex enterprise deals with long cycles and several stakeholders, ideally in financial services, insurance, pharma or life sciences.

  • You know how risk, compliance or IT buyers think, from selling GRC, security, data or AI software, or from working on the buyer side.

  • You have a network among these buyers in the Netherlands or elsewhere in Northwest Europe.

  • You can discuss the EU AI Act and how AI systems are built and monitored with some confidence. You don’t need to be an engineer.

  • You’ve worked at an early-stage company or founded one, and you’re comfortable building pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluent English. Dutch or German is a strong plus.

What the role is, and what it is not

It is a builder role. Deal ownership comes first, commercial process a close second.

It is not a lead-execution seat, and you don’t carry the number alone. The founders stay close to deals and are responsible for the commercial function.

What we offer

  • Competitive base and bonus

  • Share plan from day 1

  • Pension plan and other benefits

  • Hybrid working from The Stack in Amsterdam, home to around 40 AI startups

  • The chance to be part of an early stage startup, building the sales function and grow with it

Hiring process

  1. Application: your CV or LinkedIn, and something you’ve worked on that you’re proud of

  2. Introductory call (30 minutes)

  3. Conversation with two people you’d work with closely (60 minutes)

  4. Case study (3 hours, timeboxed), presented to two team members

  5. Offer

General Manager, Communication, Media, Entertainment and Technology - US-Based

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the General Manager for Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology (CMET) at Toptal, you will be the visionary architect of our growth strategy in this dynamic industry. We’re seeking a hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial spirit who can inspire and scale a world-class team to drive exponential growth in our enterprise customer base.

In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Senior Leadership to unlock transformative market opportunities and identify the highest-potential avenues for value creation. Your strategic insight and foresight will be pivotal in shaping the future of Toptal’s presence in the CMET landscape.

You will lead from the front, rolling up your sleeves to work directly with your sales team in forging and nurturing relationships with Fortune 500 companies. Your ability to strategically target and close deals will be integral to our success, positioning Toptal as a leader in the industry.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth, a knack for crafting compelling strategies, and the ability to execute at the highest level, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Define strategy & execute tactics to acquire key target prospects while deepening strategic relationships with CMET portfolio clients.
  • Cultivate relationships with Senior leaders at accounts in your team’s portfolio.
  • Leverage your professional network connections to expand reach within your industry.
  • Develop hypotheses to drive the team’s Go-to-Market Strategy and expand Toptal’s presence within Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • Develop & prioritize industry-specific offerings in alignment with Category Service Leaders
  • Evaluate and evolve the team’s short-, medium-, and long-term plan to establish Toptal as the leading provider of professional services in the enterprise space.
  • Develop account prioritization criteria and work with members of the team to optimize account portfolios and engagement strategies.
  • Develop account plans and relationship maps by leveraging industry insights.
  • Lead a team of experienced Sales & Client Services professionals to expand Toptal’s professional services market share within the Communication, Media, Entertainment, and Technology industries.
  • Regularly meet with Sales Director & CMET team members to review KPIs, provide guidance to increase deal velocity, evaluate performance, and develop coaching plans.
  • Lead with both inspiration and accountability, establishing clear performance standards, providing direct feedback in real time, and driving execution through focused, consistent coaching.
  • Actively recruit new members to join our rapidly growing team

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Learn our sales method and our selling process.
  • Meet the team and understand targets and goals.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Build your initial GTM strategy for CMET in partnership with Services GMs, iterating based on feedback from clients while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Get up to speed on your industry territory and understand priority focus areas at the portfolio level

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.

  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and the ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Content Marketing Manager

Influ2 brings ABM to the contact level. With Influ2, you can act on contact-level intent, reach specific buyers with ads, orchestrate journeys across channels, and make the revenue impact clear.

200+ enterprises and mid-market companies worldwide, including industry leaders such as Snowflake, AppsFlyer, and Capgemini, love our technology. We hope you will love it too.

Who we are looking for:

We're looking for a Content Marketing Manager who knows the difference between content that's worth someone's time and content that just fills a page.

A content creator with a perspective that goes beyond what AI can generate, strong writing skills, a feel for what resonates with people, and a sharp editorial instinct.

You'll own Influ2's content strategy and execution across channels, from website and blog content to thought leadership and email marketing.

You'll work closely with every marketing function, especially SEO, to make sure our content is both genuinely good and effective.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys shaping the direction and doing the work.

What you'll do:

  • Content strategy: Own our content strategy and editorial calendar. Identify the topics, stories, and formats worth investing in, and connect content priorities to our goals.
  • Content creation: Write, edit, and produce content across our website, blog, thought leadership, customer stories, reports, and other formats.
  • SEO and GEO growth: Partner closely with SEO to create content that earns visibility without sacrificing quality.
  • Email marketing content: Own the content and copy for email marketing, including newsletter, nurture sequences, campaign emails, and customer comms.
  • Content distribution: Work with channel owners to find opportunities to extend the life and impact of strong content.
  • Editorial quality: Set and maintain a high editorial standard across everything we publish, making sure our content is clear, distinctive, and worth someone's attention.

What success looks like: Influ2 produces content that people recognize, remember, and want to engage with, and that impact shows up in the pipeline. Marketing teams see you as a creative and strategic partner who brings strong ideas.

Your experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in content marketing or editorial roles, preferably within B2B technology or SaaS. Experience in martech, adtech, or ABM is a strong plus.
  • A strong portfolio of content you've personally written that shows original thinking, excellent writing, and the ability to work across formats.
  • Experience owning content strategy and execution, from developing ideas to production and performance analysis that informs editorial and strategic decisions.

Your skills:

  • You have strong editorial instincts. You can recognize a great idea, spot a boring one, and explain what would make it better.
  • You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated topics feel simple without stripping away what makes them valuable.
