At Influ2, we highly appreciate a wide range of experiences and backgrounds. So, even if your history doesn't perfectly match our list, we would still be delighted to receive your application and learn more about you!

What's in it for you?

  • Have a direct impact on how Influ2 tells its story and builds its voice in the market.
  • Own content across the business, with room to experiment, introduce new formats, and bring your own ideas to life.
  • Remote work flexibility with no fixed working hours; work where and when it suits you.
  • Unlimited vacation policy to support a healthy work-life balance.
  • Generous parental leave and other well-structured PTO policies.
  • A well-rounded health package with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

We’ve raised a total of $15 million in our Series A round, maintaining a cash-positive business for the past 24 months while achieving 50% growth.

We're convinced that the diverse ideas and experiences every Influ2encer brings are the key to our success. To make sure our culture and products reflect this blend of viewpoints and backgrounds, there's no room for discrimination here. Our approach to hiring, training, promoting, and compensating individuals is grounded in merit and competence.

We're committed to offering equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, no matter their race, age, religion, where they come from, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Everyone at Influ2 plays a part in keeping our workplace welcoming and free from discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive, Financial Institutions (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Business Development Executive, Financial Institutions (EMEA)

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

You will expand TRM’s strategic access across the EMEA financial institution ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role, designed for someone who already has deep credibility and trusted relationships across banks, and financial institutions. You are not being hired to build a network from scratch. You are being hired to activate a network you have already earned.

This is not a traditional closing-quota sales role. Your mandate is to open senior-level conversations, multi-thread strategic accounts, create qualified enterprise opportunities, and help TRM become part of the most important digital asset, financial crime, and compliance conversations happening inside major financial institutions.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Open senior-level access at priority EMEA financial institutions by activating a network you have already built.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships across the stakeholders who shape digital asset strategy, financial crime programs, compliance priorities, investigations, risk, and innovation.

  • Help TRM earn a seat in the most important conversations happening inside strategic financial institutions

  • Identify and pursue high-value enterprise and partnership opportunities with banks and other financial institutions.

  • Represent TRM externally at conferences, executive forums, practitioner communities, and industry events, turning public presence and private conversations into qualified opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Policy to turn strategic access into qualified customer opportunities, market insight, and long-term competitive advantage.

  • Turn market, technology, and regulatory shifts into an early-warning system for TRM, helping the company spot opportunities and risks before competitors do.

  • Close the loop between field signal and internal strategy by feeding customer insights, buying dynamics, objections, and market intelligence back into TRM’s product and GTM teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep, credible network across EMEA financial institutions, ideally from having been head of digital assets at a bank, or from operating at a crypto infrastructure firm

  • Comfortable being customer-facing and public-facing: conferences, panels, thought leadership

  • Track record of turning relationships into real pipeline, not just introductions

  • Already uses AI day-to-day for research, prospecting, and pipeline management, with a concrete workflow to point to

Hard Requirements

  • Based remotely within Europe

  • Willing to travel 30-40% for conferences and in-person account work

  • Direct experience with financial institutions or crypto-native infrastructure companies serving them in EMEA

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Full-Time Europe

jobs.description:
Engineering Manager, AI CICD

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain, and we're building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead a fast-moving team shipping tools that developers will actually use — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and new products built on our microVM sandbox platform.

You'll own these products end-to-end: hire and grow the team, set the roadmap with Product, and stay hands-on enough to dig into the code. This is a high-ownership role for someone who moves fast, takes initiative, and measures success by what ships and who uses it.

What you'll do:

  • Own a portfolio of products end-to-end — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and emerging microVM-based products — from roadmap through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Hire, lead, and grow a small team of strong engineers. Remove blockers and create the conditions for them to do their best work.
  • Stay technically hands-on: review designs and PRs, prototype when it unblocks the team, and unblock the team
  • Partner closely with Product on a roadmap with real deadlines — help the team prioritize tradeoffs and ship iteratively rather than waiting for perfect.
  • Navigate ambiguous problems and find a clear path forward. You take initiative rather than waiting for complete specs.
  • Own the quality and reliability of what you ship, and stay close to customers to turn their feedback directly into the roadmap.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years experience managing engineers with a genuine, sustained passion for leading and growing a team.
  • A track record of shipping products or major features and owning the results.
  • Strong technical background — you can still read code, review designs, and reason about architecture and tradeoffs. Proficiency with Go or strong readiness to ramp quickly.
  • Experience building CI/CD systems, developer tooling, or product-facing platforms; familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with AI tooling and genuine enthusiasm for applying it to complex customer problems
  • Comfort with autonomy and ambiguity, a bias for action, and a habit of shipping iteratively.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Counsel
jobs.description:
Counsel

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

What You'll Do

  • Draft, review, and revise commercial agreements, including NDAs, vendor agreements, customer contracts, and other day-to-day agreements across the business.

  • Support contract negotiations by preparing drafts and redlines, researching issues, and working with senior members of the Legal team to resolve open points.

  • Assist with product and regulatory matters, including researching legal requirements, reviewing product materials and disclosures, and helping prepare terms, policies, notices, and other customer-facing materials.

  • Research federal and state laws and regulations affecting Flex and help turn that research into clear, practical guidance for the Legal & Compliance team and our business partners.

  • Support regulatory and licensing work, including preparing filings, gathering information, maintaining records, and helping respond to requests from regulators, banks, and other partners.

  • Assist with disputes, litigation, collections, and recovery matters, including researching claims, organizing records, preparing correspondence, and coordinating with internal teams and outside counsel.

  • Help maintain Flex's corporate records and support governance and other general corporate matters.

  • Work directly with teams across Flex to gather facts, understand business needs, and help the Legal team respond quickly and effectively.

  • Help build and improve the templates, playbooks, processes, and tools we use to make the Legal function more efficient.

  • Use AI and other technology as part of your everyday practice, and help us find new ways to automate routine legal work and make the entire team better.

What Makes You A Great Fit

  • You're smart, curious, and eager to learn. You don't need to know everything yet - we don't expect you to. But you want to understand why things work the way they do, and you're willing to dig until they make sense.

  • You take pride in your work. Details matter to you. You proofread. You check your work. And you don't consider something finished just because you've reached the bottom of the page.

  • You're comfortable asking questions. You know there's a difference between figuring something out and guessing, and you're not afraid to ask for guidance when you need it.

  • You learn quickly. You take feedback well, apply it the next time, and want your second attempt at something to be noticeably better than your first.

  • You're a strong writer and clear thinker. You can research an unfamiliar issue, identify what matters, and explain what you've found without burying the answer.

  • You're organized and dependable. If you're given an assignment, you keep track of it, communicate about it, and get it done.

  • You want to understand the business. You're interested in more than the legal answer. You want to understand what Flex is building, how our products work, and why the question matters in the first place.

  • You're willing to do the work. No assignment is beneath you, and you understand that becoming a great lawyer means getting the fundamentals right before anything else.

  • You're comfortable with change. Priorities move quickly at a startup, new questions come up constantly, and you won't always have a form, precedent, or perfectly defined assignment waiting for you.

  • You want responsibility and are ready to earn it. We'll give you meaningful work, support, and opportunities to grow. What you do with those opportunities is up to you.

What We're Looking For

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and an active bar license, or eligibility to become admitted promptly.

  • 0–2 years of legal experience. Law firm, in-house, government, judicial clerkship, and other relevant legal experience will all be considered.

  • Strong academic, legal research, writing, and analytical skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, thoughtful work.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

  • Good judgment, including knowing when to work through an issue independently and when to ask for help.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with lawyers and non-lawyers across the company.

  • An interest in contracts and commercial work and a desire to develop strong drafting and negotiation skills.

  • An interest in fintech, financial services, technology, or startups. Prior experience in these areas is helpful, but not required.

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to learn how to use it responsibly to research, draft, analyze, and work more efficiently.

  • A willingness to take on a broad range of assignments and learn different areas of an in-house legal practice.

  • Genuine excitement about Flex and the opportunity to grow as a lawyer while helping us build the company.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Full-Time USA

Lead Fullstackenwtickler:in

Deine Superpower:

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle – including discovering and validating therapeutic targets and developing patient stratification strategies. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

  • Generate novel therapeutic hypothesis for diseases with unmet need, mining the in-house data resources using statistical approaches to understand the causal pathophysiology of disease, identify and triage potential targets with genetic evidence, and build a rich understanding of the cell types, cellular function, tissue-level characteristics, patient populations and biomarkers needed to support a development program.

  • Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information (through polygenic risk scores) with conventional risk factors, to find those individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from particular therapies.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

Who You Are

Must have, solid foundations in:

  • Statistics (modelling, regression)

  • Genetics and molecular biology

  • Statistical programming (e.g., Python or R)

Preferred:

  • Experience using a broad array of statistical genetics approaches (e.g., GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores)

  • Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records.

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference.

  • Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding, containerisation)

  • Experience building and running reproducible pipelines e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow.

  • Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments e.g. DNAnexus or Verily Workbench.

  • Experience with methods development within statistical genetics

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Nous étendons en continu la couverture d'Alassio à de nouvelles conventions collectives et à de nouveaux dispositifs réglementaires. Chaque paramétrage se retrouve sur des milliers de bulletins : ta rigueur garantit la justesse des paies de nos cabinets, et ta réactivité leur permet d'obtenir vite les ajustements dont ils ont besoin.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu fais évoluer le moteur de paie d'Alassio : c'est toi qui traduis les règles de paie (conventions collectives, dispositifs réglementaires, cas particuliers) en paramétrage fiable, utilisé par tous nos cabinets. Tu travailles avec les équipes Métier et Juridique à l'extension réglementaire d'Alassio, en t'appuyant sur les workflows IA d'intégration et de mise à jour des paramètres légaux et conventionnels que nous avons développés.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Réaliser et maintenir le paramétrage du moteur : rubriques, cotisations, profils de paie et conventions collectives

  • Traiter les demandes de paramétrage de bout en bout : diagnostic, analyse, paramétrage et livraison, en lien avec notre équipe Juridique

  • Requalifier les cas limites : distinguer ce qui relève du moteur, du paramétrage propre au dossier du cabinet ou d'une évolution produit

  • Mettre en œuvre les évolutions réglementaires : analyser, paramétrer et tester les changements de taux, de plafonds et de règles

  • Traiter les corrections issues du support : vérifier et ajuster les modifications analysées, puis les valider et les implémenter

  • Tester chaque paramétrage livré : tests de conformité et de non-régression, construction et entretien des jeux de tests

  • Fiabiliser le workflow IA d'intégration des CCN : contrôler, tester et corriger ce qu'il produit

  • Gérer la file des demandes : prioriser, suivre et accompagner la validation des livrables

  • Documenter les paramétrages réalisés

  • Analyser des cas clients pour identifier l'origine d'un écart de calcul

  • Remonter au Product les anomalies et les besoins d'évolution du produit

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique)

  • Tu travailles également avec l'équipe Support, l'équipe Tech et l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA)

  • Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, outils d'IA développés par Alassio

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le moteur de paramétrage et le workflow IA des CCN, et tes premières corrections sont validées en binôme

  • À 3 mois : tu reprends en autonomie le paramétrage quotidien, avec des jeux de tests de non-régression en place sur ton périmètre

  • À 6 mois : tu pilotes en autonomie une campagne d'évolutions réglementaires et tu tiens les délais de traitement des corrections

Du bringst Ordnung hinein: Du erkennst, was brennt, löst selbst, was du lösen kannst, und gibst den Rest gezielt an die richtigen Specialist Engineers weiter. Unsere Kunden merken davon vor allem eines, nämlich dass es funktioniert.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Unseren Helpdesk verstehen wir als intelligente, agentengestützte Serviceplattform und nicht als Ticketsystem. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

  • Den Überblick behalten: Du übernimmst die Ticket-Triage im B2B-Helpdesk, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Case beim richtigen Menschen landet.

  • Selbst lösen: Second-Level-Anfragen rund um Microsoft 365 bearbeitest du eigenständig, vom Troubleshooting über die Konfiguration bis zur Wurzelursachenanalyse. Du willst wissen, warum etwas kaputt war, und nicht nur, dass es wieder läuft.

  • SLAs im Griff haben: Du überwachst SLAs und offene Cases und greifst ein, bevor etwas eskaliert.

  • Kunden auf Augenhöhe begleiten: Du pflegst die Kundenbeziehung proaktiv. Unsere Kunden wissen, wen sie anrufen können, und vertrauen dir.

  • Im Team spielen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Operations- und Workplace-Specialists zusammen und gibst Fälle so weiter, dass niemand nachfragen muss.

  • Den Helpdesk smarter machen: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, schaust du dir genauer an. Du gestaltest mit, wie AI-Agents und automatisierte Workflows Triage, Analyse und Kommunikation im Helpdesk übernehmen.


Du passt zu uns, wenn …

jobs.title: Campaign Analyst
jobs.description:
Campaign Analyst

Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie.

  • Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.

  • Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan?

  • Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak.

  • Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré.

  • Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken.

  • Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter.

  • Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen.

  • Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

jobs.title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
jobs.description:
Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry

Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding of een mbo-4-opleiding en kunt aantoonbaar zelfstandig werken.

  • Je studeert bijvoorbeeld Technische Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Kwaliteitsmanagement, Human Factors, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je bent analytisch en oplettend, schrijft helder en kunt informatie eenvoudig en visueel overbrengen.

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en zelfstandig en legt gemakkelijk contact met collega’s op de werkvloer.

  • Je zoekt een onderzoeks- en implementatiestage, waarbij gedeeltelijk meewerken in de praktijk mogelijk is..

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. AI Engineer AivyCare

Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de huisartsenzorg

Wil jij AI-oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan toegankelijke en toekomstbestendige zorg? Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare: een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen.

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg.

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare.

  • Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows.

  • Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen.

  • Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen.

  • Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid.

  • Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden.

  • Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare.


Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. We zoeken iemand die initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en graag werkt aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is.

Jij past waarschijnlijk goed als je:

  • Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur in informatica, AI, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Ervaring hebt met softwareontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld in backend development, integraties of platformontwikkeling.

  • Affiniteit hebt met AI-toepassingen en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe je die inzet in echte producten.

  • Pragmatisch bent en goed functioneert in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

  • Kunt meedenken van concept tot realisatie en verder kijkt dan alleen je eigen code.

  • Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en begrijpt dat betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid in de zorg essentieel zijn.

  • Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines.

  • Enthousiast wordt van onze technologie stack: Java 25, Spring Boot Modulith, FHIR R4, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, React/Vite, Azure Cloud Provider.

  • Enthousiast bent over agentic development met Claude Code.

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel, maar ligt je kracht meer in fullstack, frontend development of operations? Reageer dan gerust. We zoeken bouwers met de juiste mindset; de exacte invulling van de rol bepalen we samen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. Je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, productontwikkeling en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen.

jobs.description:
Senior Business Analist / Product Owner E-health

Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

jobs.title: Technical Oversight - Processing
jobs.description:
Technical Oversight - Processing

About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Oversight - Processing with deep mortgage operations experience and strong independent judgment. This is not a traditional customer support or relationship-only role. You will act as a senior operational partner to our originating customers, owning issue resolution end-to-end and ensuring loans move cleanly, compliantly, and predictably through the lifecycle.

You will work directly with customers while collaborating closely with underwriting, processing, product, and engineering to reduce errors, prevent rework, and improve system-driven workflows. This role is ideal for someone who has worked inside the loan file, understands where mortgages break, and is motivated to help build scalable, automated systems that eliminate those failures over time.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about operating with rigor today while helping design the future of automated mortgage infrastructure, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Origination Ownership

  • Act as a operational point of contact for originating customers, owning issue resolution from identification through closure

  • Guide customers through the full loan lifecycle, providing clear, accurate direction on requirements, timelines, disclosures and next steps

  • Own the operational health of assigned loans end-to-end, ensuring files progress on schedule and close on time by proactively identifying blockers, driving resolution, and coordinating across internal teams and customers.

  • Proactively manage customer expectations to reduce inbound escalations and uncertainty

Operational Judgment & Risk Prevention

  • Independently evaluate loan scenarios to identify potential structural, disclosure, or compliance risks before they escalate

  • Catch missing, inconsistent, or incorrect inputs that could lead to redisclosures, delays, or downstream rework

  • Provide firm, professional guidance to customers when corrections or process adherence are required

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with underwriting, processing, and closing teams to ensure clean handoffs and aligned execution

  • Serve as a trusted escalation point, reducing leadership involvement by resolving complex or high-stakes issues directly

  • Coordinate with third-party vendors to ensure issues are addressed efficiently, quickly and accurately

Systems & Product Feedback

  • Identify recurring patterns, edge cases, and workflow gaps that impact loan quality or customer experience

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to help define requirements, guardrails, and operational acceptance criteria

  • Contribute real-world mortgage insight to improve automation, tooling, and system-driven decisioning

Documentation & Quality

  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation of customer interactions, decisions, and follow-ups

  • Ensure customer-facing communication aligns with regulatory requirements, internal standards, and operational best practices

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of mortgage industry experience, with hands-on roles in processing, underwriting, or a similar operational function

  • Direct experience working loans from application through CTC and closing

  • Hands-on experience with mortgage disclosures, including preparing, reviewing, or validating LEs and CDs, with a strong working knowledge of TRID timing, tolerance categories, and re-disclosure triggers.

  • Ability to independently sanity-check loan structure, including LTV, product eligibility, and basic compliance considerations

  • Prior experience serving as an escalation point for brokers, borrowers, or loan officers

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where processes are still being built

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mortgage concepts clearly and confidently

  • High attention to detail paired with strong problem-solving instincts and sound judgment

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a call-center or script-based customer support role

  • This is not a traditional CSM focused only on relationship management

  • This is not a sales or loan officer role — there are no commissions or volume-based incentives

  • This role requires independent mortgage judgment, ownership, and accountability

Benefits

Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon
Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with support for dependents
401(k): Ability to save for your future
Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off
Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to fix up your workspace
Annual Off-sites: Fully paid for team off-sites in beautiful corners of the world
At-cost Mortgages: We’ll help you finance your next home when you’re ready

Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Contract | Senior SDET (MARVEL SNAP)
jobs.description:
Contract | Senior SDET (MARVEL SNAP)

Who We Are

Second Dinner is an award-winning independent game development studio that is here to make the most fun games in the world. Not super fun games. Not SUPER DUPER fun games. We mean the MOST fun games. In fact, our game MARVEL SNAP has earned multiple Mobile Game of the Year Awards (Game Awards, DICE), Best Strategy Game (IGN), and the Apple Design Award for Innovation!

Second Dinner is a remote-first studio, so while we are headquartered in Irvine, California, most of our team is fully remote across the United States. We want the most talented teammates wherever they call home. A diverse team with varied perspectives makes us a better company and will help us make better games. If you can bring something new to the table and expand our point of view, that's a huge upside.

Our Engineering Team:

At Second Dinner, we believe that great people in a great work environment lead to great games and player experiences. In engineering, we empower our teams to build and innovate with best-in-class tools in novel ways. Our goal is to simplify game development and redefine what is possible in game development.

Your Role:

You will own and drive Marvel Snap’s Test Automation initiative, as well as perform various DevOps duties. You will report to the Lead Engineer of the Live Stability team and collaborate with QA analysts, engineers, and artists to create test suites, build pipelines, and develop tools to ensure we deliver the highest quality games possible to our players! If you’re passionate about testing, automation, validation, and continuous integration, then we'd love to hear from you!

This is a 6-month contract role to start (with possible extension), but if it's a great mutual fit, it could evolve into a full-time position.

What You’ll Do:

  • As an automation superhero, you’ll identify, design, and deliver technical solutions (frameworks, tests, API hooks, tools) that increase test effectiveness, coverage, and overall development velocity

  • Build and enhance continuous integration and delivery pipelines to support development teams across MARVEL SNAP

  • Own the long-term development and roadmap of test automation

  • Implement metrics, analyze test data to identify patterns, and report on risk status to help enhance software quality

  • Optimize testing efforts and develop new opportunities using automation that will empower the QA team to be more effective and efficient

  • Automate everything: from command lines to complex workflows, find opportunities to improve how we build and test the game, ultimately to improve the player experience

What You’ll Need:

  • Demonstrated ability designing and owning scalable automated testing solutions, including test frameworks, test infrastructure, and execution pipelines

  • Proficiency in unit and integration test frameworks in C#/.NET or other object-oriented programming language

  • Experience integrating test pipelines into CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins

  • Knowledge of industry best testing practices, including unit, integration, end-to-end, acceptance, functional, and performance testing

  • Ability to work independently, charting the course for the company in test automation

  • Passion for empowering teams with best-in-class automated testing tools, frameworks, and test harnesses to improve operations

  • An agile mindset, a desire for constant improvement of tooling, automation, and process to improve the quality of our products and the lives of our teammates

  • High levels of empathy and support for team members, both technical and non-technical

  • Passion for playing and making great games

Nice to Have, But Not Necessary:

  • Experience with test automation in Unity, such as Unity Test Runner

  • Experience with mobile, web, or game automation frameworks such as Appium, Selenium, Playwright, or GameDriver

  • Experience developing on-device automated test pipelines for either physical hardware devices or using platforms such as AWS Device Farm or Kobiton

  • Experience with test case management systems such as TestRail or qTest

This position pays a range of $72-82 per hour (USD).

Individual pay within this range may span multiple levels within the discipline and is determined by assessed job-related skills, experience, relevant education, or training. It also factors in market demands and business needs. The disclosed range is not adjusted based on location and may be subject to change or modification based on business needs in the future. This role is contracted through a third-party that provides health benefits, etc., which we can discuss more during the hiring process.

We are an equal opportunity employer that places high value on diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, disability status, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military status, or veteran status.

You must be legally authorized to work and reside in the United States. We do not sponsor visas or support employment outside the U.S. for this role.

jobs.description:
Salesforce Developer

About Us:

Nivoda: Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎

At Nivoda, we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.

We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.

Our Mission

The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.

The Engineering & RevOps Team

Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. Senior Capture Manager

Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators - Public Sector

As the Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators (FSI), you will lead joint capture and channel coordination across Datadog's federal systems integrator and prime-contractor ecosystem, serving as the connective tissue between those partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams. You will make sure capture activity happening inside FSI partner organizations is visible to, aligned with, and reinforced by Datadog's own federal sellers, and vice versa, so that partner-led and direct-led motions strengthen a pursuit rather than duplicate or collide with it. The role reports to the Channel & Alliances (C&A) organization and works cross-functionally with federal sales, distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft), deal desk, and legal to drive joint capture outcomes on priority federal pursuits.

Travel: Less than 25%

Clearance: An active U.S. government security clearance is preferred but not required. Candidates without an active clearance are encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the joint-capture strategy and partner alignment for a portfolio of approximately 20 priority federal programs, engaging 12-24 months ahead of RFP release
  • Manage each named program as a distinct capture effort, coordinating dedicated engagement across agency stakeholders, FSI partners, and independent software vendors (ISVs)

  • Identify and resolve channel conflict early, surfacing where a partner-led and direct-led pursuit are converging on the same account or contract vehicle and brokering a single aligned approach
  • Partner with distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft) to keep pricing, SKU naming, and quoting consistent across contract vehicles, including the GSA Schedule and SEWP (Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement)
  • Coordinate teaming strategy with FSI partners, including how partners team with primes and other systems integrators, and flag most-favored-nation (MFN) or pricing-consistency issues to deal desk before they become customer-facing problems

  • Build durable working relationships with FSI partner capture and Business Development (BD) leads and with Datadog's federal account teams so coordination happens proactively, not only when escalated

ABOUT LEGION

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)
jobs.description:
Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations.

You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson.

You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable.

  • Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management.

  • Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate.

  • Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs.

  • Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable.

  • Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands.

  • Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release.

  • Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback.

  • Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware.

  • Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks.

  • Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

What success looks like

  • Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template.

  • Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code.

  • Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field.

  • Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack.

jobs.title: GTM System Engineer
jobs.description:
GTM System Engineer

About Us:

Nivoda: where innovation and gemstones meet

At Nivoda, we help jewellery retailers and gemstone suppliers trade more easily. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery businesses of all sizes with global diamond and gemstone supply.

Nivoda has more than 400 employees across the world. Our platform helps buyers and sellers trade diamonds and gemstones securely, efficiently and at competitive prices.

The Data & Financial Platform team

The Data & Financial Platform team owns Nivoda's data platform plus the shared financial capabilities of the marketplace. Its job is to make core data and financial systems reliable, useful and scalable.

This role sits in the team but works day to day with GTM. You will work with the Head of Data, engineers, analysts, Sales and Marketing as we rebuild Nivoda's GTM infrastructure.

About the role

Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.

You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io, enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.

What would you be doing?

  • Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.

  • Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.

  • Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.

  • Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.

  • Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.

  • Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.

  • Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

What do we need from you?

  • 2+ years in software, systems or integration engineering. You have shipped real integrations or services using APIs, webhooks or event-driven systems.

  • Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. Working SQL plus confidence using Git and code review.

  • Experience integrating with business systems such as CRM, payments, finance, marketing or operations platforms. Salesforce experience is useful but not required.

  • You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders. You can challenge an unclear request and turn the underlying need into something buildable.

  • You can learn unfamiliar systems quickly, then choose the simplest solution that will hold up in production.

  • You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a marketplace or a company selling to small businesses at volume.

  • Hands-on time with an iPaaS or workflow tool such as n8n, Zapier or Workato.

  • Familiarity with tools in our stack such as Snowflake, Customer.io, Gong, Clay or similar systems.

  • Experience with cloud runtimes, CI/CD, observability or production support.

Our culture and what we offer

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • Private health insurance

  • Opportunities for growth and learning

  • Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you: we would still love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role:

As an AI Strategist, you are the embedded AI leader for our customers. You connect what customers are saying in their conversations, what their business needs most, and what Cresta's AI can do, then turn that into a prioritized plan and measurable results. You identify where automation and augmentation will deliver the most value, build the roadmap, and make sure the work ships and pays off.

You will not be building AI Agents from scratch. Our Forward Deployed Engineers and Forward Deployed Product Managers create and deploy them. Your focus is on making deployed AI better: finding the next opportunity, optimizing what is already live, piloting new Cresta capabilities, and proving the business impact. You are analytical, commercially minded, and credible with senior stakeholders in CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT. You are technical enough to work closely with FDEs and FDPMs and to give product and engineering a tight feedback loop.

What You'll Do:

AI Strategy and Roadmap

  • Identify automation and augmentation opportunities across the customer's contact center and wider customer experience operation.
  • Prioritize initiatives by expected ROI and build a business case for each one.
  • Build and maintain the customer's enterprise AI roadmap, and keep it current as priorities and Cresta capabilities change.
  • Align stakeholders across CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT on priorities, sequencing, and success criteria.

Conversation Intelligence and Business Insights

  • Use conversation data to surface customer friction and emerging trends before they show up in other metrics.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and the changes that would reduce them.
  • Share Voice of Customer insights with customer leadership and with Cresta product teams.
  • Measure business impact and report it in terms executives care about, such as containment, handle time, conversion, CSAT, and cost to serve.

AI Innovation and Execution

  • Stay current on new Cresta features and bring the relevant ones to customers early.
  • Pilot emerging AI capabilities, define how success will be judged, and decide with the customer whether to scale them.
  • Optimize live AI Agents by analyzing performance, reviewing conversations, and recommending changes to prompts, workflows, and configurations.
  • Coordinate deployments with FDEs, FDPMs, and customer teams, including milestones, timelines, and dependencies.
  • Measure realized value after launch and report it back against the original business case.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ years in technology consulting, strategy, product, analytics, implementation, or customer success roles, ideally with AI or LLM-first products.
  • Strategic and commercial skills: A track record of building roadmaps, prioritizing by ROI, and writing business cases that senior stakeholders approve.
  • Analytical approach: Strong data skills. You are comfortable analyzing conversation or operational data, designing experiments such as A/B tests, and monitoring performance to refine solutions.
  • Technical understanding: Working knowledge of how LLM-based AI agents function, including prompts, tools or function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation. Hands-on experience with an agent project, even a personal one, is a plus. You do not need to write production code, but you can read and reason about system behavior and discuss tradeoffs with engineers.
  • Stakeholder leadership: Experience leading cross-functional work and influencing senior customer stakeholders across CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT.
  • Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. You can explain a complex finding to an executive in plain language.
  • Execution: Strong project management skills and a bias for action. You turn ambiguity into a plan and follow it through to results.
  • Mindset: Curious, self-driven, and comfortable learning quickly in a fast-moving startup environment. You are passionate about AI, automation, and the future of customer experience.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with conversation intelligence, speech analytics, or voice-of-customer programs
  • Background in management consulting, product management, or forward deployed roles

  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
